display_long_description:
Build your dream hotel empire from the ground up in this addictive idle tycoon VR simulation!

Start with a small hotel and turn it into a world-class luxury empire. Manage rooms, upgrade facilities, serve guests, and expand your business across multiple floors and locations. Every decision helps your hotel grow bigger, better, and more profitable!

🌟 Game Features

🏨 Build Your Hotel Empire
Start small and expand into a massive luxury hotel chain.

💰 Idle Income System
Earn money even when you're offline and keep growing your empire.

🛏️ Upgrade Everything
Improve rooms, lobby, services, and staff to increase profits.

👨‍💼 Hotel Management Gameplay
Hire staff, manage guests, and keep your hotel running smoothly.

🌍 Expand Your Business
Unlock new areas, floors, and hotels as you become a true tycoon.

🥽 Immersive VR Experience
Enjoy a fun and relaxing virtual reality hotel simulation.

⚡ Easy to Play, Hard to Master
Simple controls with deep progression and strategy.

🎮 Become the Ultimate Hotel Tycoon

Turn a small hotel into a global empire. Optimize your earnings, upgrade faster, and build the most successful hotel chain in the world!

Can you become the richest hotel tycoon?
